incidents.name: Incident on 2015-03-29 08:05:16 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2015-03-29 08:05:16 - Minor service outage.
  • 2015-03-29 08:18:34 - The ongoing DDoS attack has changed tactics. We are experiencing intermittent service outages and working to mitigate.
  • 2015-03-29 10:53:53 - Services are stable as we continue to mitigate against a large scale DDoS attack.
  • 2015-03-29 14:52:39 - The ongoing DDoS attack is affecting connectivity to Gist. We're working to mitigate further disruption.
  • 2015-03-29 17:21:21 - 87 hours in, our mitigation is deflecting most attack traffic. We're aware of intermittent issues and continue to adapt our response.
  • 2015-03-29 19:25:41 - We've adjusted our mitigation tactics and are observing improved TCP performance for the majority of non-attack traffic.
  • 2015-03-30 00:38:27 - All systems reporting at 100%. Attack traffic continues, so we remain on high alert.
  • 2015-03-30 06:46:44 - The DDoS attack has evolved and we are working to mitigate
  • 2015-03-30 11:50:44 - All systems reporting at 100%. Attack traffic continues, so we remain on high alert.
  • 2015-03-30 19:32:39 - After 113 hours of sustained DDoS attacks our defenses are holding. We will keep our status at yellow until the threat has subsided.
  • 2015-03-31 00:09:29 - Hour 118: Mitigation remains effective and service is stable.
  • 2015-03-31 11:11:31 - Everything operating normally.

incidents.name: Incident on 2015-03-27 14:45:37 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2015-03-27 14:45:37 - The attack has ramped up again, and we're evolving our mitigation strategies to match.
  • 2015-03-27 15:04:59 - We've deployed our volumetric attack defenses against an extremely large amount of traffic. Performance is stabilizing.
  • 2015-03-27 15:49:12 - We're aware that GitHub.com is intermittently unavailable for some users during the ongoing DDoS. Restoring service for all users while deflecting attack traffic is our number one priority.
  • 2015-03-27 19:23:56 - The on-going DDoS attack now includes GitHub Pages. We are working to mitigate any service disruption.
  • 2015-03-27 22:41:06 - We are continuing to defend GitHub against a very large DDoS attack.
  • 2015-03-28 02:30:44 - The ongoing DDoS attack has shifted to include Pages and assets. We are updating our defenses to match.
  • 2015-03-28 04:46:35 - The ongoing DDoS attack has adjusted tactics again. We are continuing to adapt and mitigate it.
  • 2015-03-28 10:00:47 - The ongoing DDoS attack has shifted again to include Pages and assets. We are updating our defenses to match.
  • 2015-03-28 16:18:15 - We are working to mitigate an ongoing and evolving large DDoS attack.
  • 2015-03-29 00:50:52 - Into hour 71 defending the attack. Mitigation is holding and service is stable.
  • 2015-03-29 06:34:37 - While the attack is ongoing, mitigation continues to hold and service is stable. We remain on high alert in case the attack evolves.

incidents.name: Incident on 2015-03-27 08:31:05 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2015-03-27 08:31:05 - At this time we're fully operational but we're still mitigating the ongoing DDoS attack and there may be intermittent connectivity issues as we continue working on the problem
  • 2015-03-27 10:00:22 - We continue to respond to an ongoing DDoS attack. Some users may experience intermittent connectivity with git operations as we mitigate the problem.
  • 2015-03-27 12:33:36 - The DDoS attack is still ongoing, but connectivity is back to normal as we continue mitigation. We're keeping a close eye on our traffic for any abnormalities.

incidents.name: Incident on 2015-03-27 06:29:07 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2015-03-27 06:29:07 - The DDoS attack is amplifying again. We are working to mitigate with all hands on deck.
  • 2015-03-27 07:25:06 - Everything operating normally.
